MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 22
   C. 44
   D. 105

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 36
   C. 77
   D. 18

3. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

7. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

11. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

12. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 10
   C. 100
   D. 50

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. C — 44
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Perimeter = 2(L + W)
2. Substitute values: P = 2(15 + 7)
3. P = 2(22)
4. P = 44
Final Answer: 44 cm
